entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. Order number is VF88-21-B.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The device is not working. It's supposed to track my cadence, but it just won't sync with the app. I've tried everything.
I see. So you're saying it's completely broken and won't connect at all?
Yes, that's what I said. It's defective. I just want to return it and get my money back.
Understood. Let me just pull up your order and check the return eligibility. One moment, please.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I see the order was delivered on December 15th, which was 20 days ago. According to our policy, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you.
Good. So you'll email me a shipping label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. You should receive an email with a prepaid return label within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the defective band back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Alright, that's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
